newsitem.title: UK: TI to split into seven units - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: TI to split into seven units - newspaper.

text.p: British engineering group TI Group Plc, is to unbundle its three operating divisions into seven distinct units in a drive to expand business, the Financial Times newspaper reported on Monday.
Each unit would have a chief executive or equivalent, the paper said.
"We have tended to be driven by shareholder value," Sir Christopher Lewinton, TI chairman and chief executive was quoted by the paper as saying. "Now we want more growth in the top line sales."
The change would maximise expansion opportunities within its three main business areas of specialist seals, fluid control systems and aerospace equipment, the paper said.
